title: Org Role card
description: The machine-readable card of one Org Role (knowledge/product/roles/<role>/role.json). Concept model v2 D6: an Org Role carries no permissions of its own; default_grant only points at registry entries (an Authority Role card and a base Authority Role). pnpm kyberion sync org-role-grants projects the cards into role-authority-map.json.

role.description: The Org Role id; equals the directory name.

role_class.description: system: maintains Kyberion itself; mission: executes user work; context: knowledge-only (no runtime authority). The role-authority-map.json group is <role_class>_roles.

authority_role.description: An Authority Role card in knowledge/product/governance/authority-roles/, or null when the role has no Authority Role.

base_role.description: The base Authority Role short name (sovereign, ecosystem_architect, worker, analyst) the role runs on by default; its card base_<name>.json must exist.

execution_mode.description: How the role executes: maintaining the system, inside a mission, or as the sovereign's concierge.
